notes.title: Version 0.7.69 Update
notes.notes:
Bugs fixed:

Purification Box Issue: Fixed the inability to exit by pressing "X" when fewer than 4 items are placed in the box.

Paper Doll Count Error: In the office building lobby, the number of paper dolls wrongly counted as 0 when 1 was left.

Menu Freeze Bug: Fixed the player being unable to move right after closing the menu due to Joe's shield skill.

Optimization:

Task Key Binding: Changed the "Alt" key function from "hold" to "click" for task activation.

Purification Box UI:

  - Added error hints for invalid items placed in the box.

  - Temporarily hides the ring and the coin when selecting the obsession items.

Sanity System:

  - Significantly reduced sanity consumption from cursed items.

  - Increased the quantity of sanity-restoring items in OMG mail attachments.

Workflow Improvements:

  - Optimized the messages for interaction points during the "Retrieve ID card" process.

  - Simplified the ID card usage procedure.

notes.title: Version 0.7.68 Update
notes.notes:
Bug Fixed:

In Jolin's room, Joe's defense against the Peachwood Sword fails to trigger the storyline.

The player can walk upward through the wall near the meeting room door.

After the purification, detection items remain usable.

Optimizations:

Revised the dialogue after failed Spirit Pad attempts, strengthening the connection between ghost reactions and questions.

Updated the OMG email to clarify the descriptions of the Spirit Pad and Voodoo doll.
